_comment: Editable content for the Oikos USA OneSearch dashboard. Edit this file and rebuild with build_dashboard.py. Run with --finalize to bake content as static HTML.

recommendations.title: Expand product page coverage for high-volume protein drink keywords
bullets: Create or optimize pages for 'protein drink', 'protein shake', 'drinkable yogurt' — top-volume uncovered product queries
Target keywords with >10K monthly searches and <3% OneSearch coverage
Align page titles and H1s to exact-match high-volume variants
Internal link from yogurt category pages to protein drink pages

recommendations.title: Create evaluate-funnel category pages for Greek yogurt and protein snack discovery
bullets: Build a 'Best High-Protein Yogurt' comparison/evaluation page targeting commercial-intent queries
Target 'best greek yogurt', 'healthiest yogurt', 'high protein yogurt' — users in evaluation mode
Include product comparison table, nutritional highlights, and brand positioning
Target featured snippet with structured comparison markup

recommendations.title: Build informational content for protein-source queries
bullets: Create hub page: 'Oikos as a Protein Source' targeting 'protein for muscle gain', 'protein for muscle building'
Sub-pages for key fitness use cases: post-workout recovery, daily protein intake, muscle building
Link from product pages to protein-source content to build topical authority
Target featured snippets with structured Q&A content

recommendations.title: Develop recipe content targeting high-volume Greek yogurt recipe queries
bullets: Publish 5-10 recipe pages targeting 'Greek yogurt recipe', 'protein smoothie recipe', 'baking with Greek yogurt'
Each recipe page targets one primary keyword with schema markup (Recipe schema)
Cross-link recipe pages to relevant product pages
Optimize for Google Images and video rich results where applicable

recommendations.title: Create lifestyle and habit-formation content for key consumption occasions
bullets: Content for 'high protein breakfast', 'protein meal prep', 'post-workout snack' — habit-formation queries
Focus on occasions where Oikos Greek yogurt or protein shakes fit naturally
Editorial format: how-to guides, weekly meal plans, snack ideas
Internal linking from product and recipe pages

recommendations.title: Apply negative keyword exclusions from Brand SEM analysis
bullets: Add 17 identified Exclude keywords as negatives in brand campaigns
All three conditions met: SEO Coverage >10% + SEO Position ≤5 + QV SEM = 0
Reallocate freed budget to Keep-Active keywords with confirmed QV SEM > 0
Monitor for 30 days post-exclusion to confirm no QV SEM drop on affected keywords

recommendations.title: Achieve 80% Impression Share on 4 priority brand keywords
bullets: Increase bids on: oikos, oikos triple zero, oikos pro, oikos yogurt
Current IS below target on these terms — competitor bidding detected
Reallocate budget freed from negative keyword exclusions to these terms
Set target IS bid strategy at campaign level for these exact match terms

recommendations.title: Monitor 8 Keep-Test keywords — pause if organic takes over
bullets: 8 keywords have SEO Coverage >10% but QV SEM >0 — organic present but paid still adding value
Review monthly: if organic holds top-5 AND QV SEM = 0 for 2 consecutive months → move to Exclude
Track week-over-week QV SEM trend for early pausing signals
Document decision in Brand SEM recommendation log

recommendations.title: Implement incrementality measurement for brand SEM
bullets: Run geo-based holdout test: pause brand SEM in select DMAs for 4 weeks
Measure organic click lift in holdout markets vs control
Use to quantify true incremental value of brand paid — informs long-term IS strategy
Results will refine the Keep-Active / Exclude thresholds for Q3

recommendations.title: Activate targeted SEM coverage for top competitor keywords
bullets: Priority competitor targets: Core Power, Premier Protein, Fairlife — high-volume switcher traffic
Build dedicated ad groups per competitor brand with tailored ad copy
Landing pages: emphasize Oikos protein content advantage and taste differentiation
Cap spend to 15% of total SEM budget — monitor QV SEM per competitor term weekly

recommendations.title: Improve Quality Score on 7 keywords below QS 5
bullets: 7 brand keywords have QS ≤5 — driving up CPC and reducing ad rank
Root cause: LP Experience rated Below Average — landing page content mismatch
Action: update landing pages for affected keywords to match ad copy intent
Rewrite ad copy for Expected CTR improvement on low-CTR ad groups

recommendations.title: Establish QV tracking cadence — monthly OneSearch review
bullets: Set monthly cadence: refresh SQR + GSC + SE Ranking exports → rerun pipeline → rebuild dashboard
Track QV SEM trend by territory each month — flag any territory with >20% QoQ drop
Add Q2 2026 vs Q1 2026 comparison column to masterlist on next run
Share updated dashboard with stakeholders by end of first week each month
